//: The TOOLING config. It includes specs and the package's own root config files so ESLint's
project service can type-aware lint them — on BOTH invocation paths (SB-15): turbo runs
`eslint .` inside the package, lint-staged runs it once from the repository root.
tsconfig.build.json narrows this to what actually ships. Solving it there rather than with
`allowDefaultProject` avoids the opposite failure: a file listed in allowDefaultProject that
IS in the project is itself a parsing error.
